faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Get your questions answered about the Unsung Professional Program.

items.question: What exactly is the Unsung Professional Program?
items.answer: It's a self-managed program for professionals who want to prepare their EB-2 NIW case step by step. It includes 9 content modules, live workshops, individual coaching and access to a private community.

items.question: Do I need a lawyer in addition to the program?
items.answer: The program prepares you to build a solid case. Many of our students complement with a lawyer for final review, but the program covers the complete strategy and preparation.

items.question: How long do I have to complete the program?
items.answer: The suggested roadmap is 90 to 120 days, but you have unlimited access to the content. You can progress at your own pace.

items.question: Are there payment options?
items.answer: Yes, we offer flexible payment plans. Contact an advisor via WhatsApp to learn about available options.

items.question: What happens if my case is denied?
items.answer: The program teaches you to build a case with the highest standards. If you receive an RFE (Request for Evidence), you have access to the post-filing strategy module and your coach to prepare the response.

items.question: Can I start if I'm not in the U.S. yet?
items.answer: Yes. The EB-2 NIW doesn't require you to be in the U.S. to start the process. You can build your case from any country.

items.question: What's the difference between UPP and Plan Plus?
items.answer: With the UPP you get the tools, templates and coaching to manage your own case. Plan Plus ($8,000) includes complete professional plan development, testimonial writing and full case management. It's for those who prefer to delegate the execution.

items.question: Do you offer a refund guarantee?
items.answer: Yes. If within the first 7 days you feel the program isn't for you, we'll refund 100% of your investment, no questions asked.
